name: Ryan's operation, with Ryan drawn
description: The same operation as ryans-operation-2026-10-01, with its owner drawn as a person (amendment A-013). Corrected by the Operator on October 1, 2026, from how Ryan and the Operator actually talk: in one chat in the Claude app, mostly on his phone, and through private pages on account B that he marks or copies a prompt back from. The names of the product's own pages are left out. Counts are for October 1, 2026, about 5 a.m. UTC.

people.name: Ryan
people.role: Owns the operation. Talks to the Operator in one chat in the Claude app, mostly on his phone; marks its private pages; reads the morning notifications; carries prompts to the sessions it cannot reach

sessions.name: Operator
sessions.role: Plans; starts, steers and checks every session on account B; merges; keeps the review pages. Extra-high effort. Leads the research project too
sessions.repo: 4 repositories: Splashery's, the research project's and two of Ryan's sites

sessions.name: Splashery lanes
sessions.role: Each builds one piece of Splashery on its own branch. Opus 5.5 now; Sonnet 5.5 for lighter work (none running)

sessions.name: Integrators
sessions.role: Run the full test suite on main plus the PRs named, and report each failure with its owner

sessions.name: One-off helpers
sessions.role: Short jobs the Operator starts when the pace allows: an audit, a catalog (two on September 30, none running now)

sessions.name: Digest and patrol
sessions.role: Read-only: a fresh session each morning reads the state (or tests the live site) and reports to Ryan's phone

sessions.name: Research lanes
sessions.role: A private research project, worked in its own lanes; the Operator is their lead

sessions.name: grooph session
sessions.role: Builds grooph: exports, operation maps and the live view. High effort

sessions.name: Codex
sessions.role: Outside checks for the research project: a prior-art review and a claim spot-check so far
